race.comment: BALLISTIC STAR (1) looks a handy one on debut for the local yard, with enough pedigree depth to command respect. Hasn't trialled publicly for nearly a year but looked smart when he did. KING OF VALHALLA (2) can rebound from a wide, costly run as beaten favourite at this venue, particularly with his earlier second to Egmont reading well. ENTERPRISE GISELLE (5) returns and looks best of the rest in her stable debut. CAPTAIN BLOOD (8) gets in well after the claim and has to be kept safe from the soft draw.
